Name: Ali's Flower Grass for Content Patcher
Author: Wrin777
Description: This is a configurable version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/816]Ali's Flower Grass[/url] using the Content Patcher system. Hopefully an official version will be released one day, but for now this unofficial port is available. The original work is attributed to Ali Read and uploaded by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]strawberrymilk95[/url].

Downloads.Description: The first and probably only version that will be uploaded, since I'm hoping the original content creator will pick up the Content Patcher stuff.
